gloss: like; just as; in the same way as

definitions.gloss: like; as; in the manner of
definitions.explanation: Attaches to a noun to compare an action or state to it. The adverbial counterpart of のような, which modifies nouns instead of verbs and adjectives.

examples.japanese: {鳥|とり}のように{飛|と}びたい。
examples.english: I want to fly like a bird.

examples.japanese: {毎年|まいとし}のように{台風|たいふう}が{来|く}る。
{先生|せんせい}がおっしゃったように、{準備|じゅんび}が{何|なに}より{大切|たいせつ}だと{分|わ}かった。
examples.english: As the teacher said, I came to see that preparation matters more than anything.

notes:
USAGE:
After a noun, use のように ({雪|ゆき}のように{白|しろ}い). After a verb or i-adjective, drop の and use ように directly ({言|い}ったように). With na-adjectives the linker is な ({静|しず}かなように).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {夢|ゆめ}のように: like a dream
- {毎日|まいにち}のように: almost every day
- {前|まえ}のように: as before
- {以下|いか}のように: as follows (written)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- のような: like — the same comparison used to modify a noun ({夢|ゆめ}のような{話|はなし})
- みたいに: like — casual spoken equivalent, attaches directly to the noun
- のごとく: like, as — literary and archaic-sounding
